{
  "root_cause": "The internal DNS server is missing the zone file for the company.com domain, so it cannot resolve internal hostnames, while external resolution succeeds via its forwarders.",
  "confidence": 95,
  "evidence": "nslookup for server1.company.com returns 'Non-existent domain' while external nslookup for google.com succeeds; directory listing of the internal DNS server shows only forwarders.conf with no company.com.zone file present.",
  "next_command": "show running-config (or view DNS server configuration) to check configured DNS zones",
  "fix_steps": [
    "Log in to the internal DNS server management interface.",
    "Create the primary forward lookup zone for company.com.",
    "Add the necessary DNS A records for the internal servers (such as server1).",
    "Test name resolution from an internal client using nslookup."
  ]
}
